scope: CVG-004 tenant-aware worker report service-principal resolution and report audit actor integrity

criteria.description: Migration 0152 extends the existing service-principal purpose allowlist without provisioning users or mapping rows.
criteria.limitations: Provisioning remains operator-owned and was not performed.

criteria.description: Report execution, export and schedule actors are constrained to the owning account and service-principal state is rechecked at persistence time.
criteria.limitations: Local disposable PostgreSQL proves the migration and trigger contract; target ownership/grants remain open.

criteria.description: The worker resolves only an active, non-interactive report service principal mapped to the current account and fails closed otherwise.
criteria.limitations: The supported topology is one valid mapping per worker/account; multi-account mapping design is not included.

criteria.description: Focused, process and regression evidence proves valid persistence, invalid-actor rejection, no execution on rejection and explicit export actor propagation.
criteria.limitations: This does not certify long-lived multi-process continuous-worker behavior.

criteria.description: Full local regression, coverage, build, typecheck, lint, security and static contract rails remain green.
criteria.limitations: Helm rendering with the binary, remote CI, target runtime and release acceptance remain unverified.

review.summary: The independent reviews remain conditional, not approvals. The first review's HIGH fixture/configuration and MEDIUM cleanup, persistence-lock and multi-account findings were corrected and retested. The follow-up review found missing persistence checks for active service-user state and actor type; migration 0152 now locks and validates those fields, with inactive-service and human-mapped rejection covered by disposable PostgreSQL 9/9. Worker-role/RLS process proof remains an explicit non-claim and the one-worker/account operating constraint remains explicit.

conditions: Provision one active non-interactive report service principal mapping per worker/account before enabling scheduled reports.
Do not create users, mappings, credentials or external resources through this migration or gate.
Obtain separate authority before designing multi-account actor configuration or changing report audit semantics.
Do not promote CVG-004, parity, enterprise readiness or release status from this bounded result.
non_claims: No target RLS/ownership or production role evidence
No provider, homologation, remote-CI, accessibility, restore or release evidence
